title: Your subscription is being confirmed
subtitle: We are reconciling your Stripe checkout with your SoccerOctopus account.
note: You can return to your account now. We will also take you there automatically.
missingSession: No checkout session was included in this return link.

pending.title: Confirming your subscription
pending.copy: This can take a moment while we verify your checkout and update your account.

complete.title: Your account is up to date
complete.copy: Your subscription has been reconciled. You can review billing and access from your profile.

retryable-error.title: We are waiting for the billing update
retryable-error.copy: Stripe may still be completing the update. You can check again or continue to your profile.
